title: The Classroom Evacuation Turns Into Chaos — Part 2

series.summary: Takashi bursts into his classroom and pulls Rei and Hisashi away, insisting that an infected killer is loose on campus. While Rei dismisses his panic as jealousy, Hisashi trusts the terror in Takashi's eyes and arms them with makeshift weapons. Their escape is interrupted when the principal's emergency evacuation broadcast abruptly turns into horrific screams as staff are devoured live over the intercom, triggering an uncontrollable stampede in the corridors.

segments.voiceover_text: Takashi kicks open the classroom door and drags Rei and Hisashi out of their seats. He desperately warns them that people are being murdered at the front gate.
Rei thinks he is overreacting, but Hisashi sees the raw terror in Takashi's eyes. He breaks a broom into an improvised spear, while Takashi grabs a wooden bat.
An emergency evacuation begins over the school intercom. Suddenly, bloodcurdling screams echo through the speakers as the staff are devoured alive.
Total pandemonium erupts. Hundreds of screaming students stampede into the hallways, straight into the jaws of the infected.
